Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0083 1. Corollary 3.10\group variation-formulas

The total scalar curvature evolves by \[ \frac{d}{dt}\int _{\M ^n}R\, d\mu =\int _{\M ^n}\Bigl(\frac12 RH-\langle \Rc ,h\rangle \Bigr)\, d\mu . \]
